title: Working late in Rosehill or Camellia? Harris Park stays open till 10pm
summary:
Rosehill and Camellia's other bakeries close by 6pm. Ours doesn't.

Harris Park stays open until 10pm, every day of the week, because a custom cake ordered for tonight shouldn't depend on leaving Parramatta CBD early. 100% eggless, always. Not some cakes, every cake, every flavour, since 2019.

Six sizes. 15 flavours, including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher. Buttercream, fondant or ganache, made to your reference photo.

48 hours minimum notice, that's what fresh baking actually takes. Order via WhatsApp on +61 425 697 725, then collect whenever your evening actually ends.
keywords: late pickup custom eggless cake Harris Park
